players.bio: Abdoul Guemissongui Ouattara (born 22 October 2005) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a full-back or midfielder for Premier League club Ipswich Town.
Abdul Fatawu Issahaku (born 8 March 2004) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Ipswich Town and the Ghana national team.
Alexander Palmer (born 10 August 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Ipswich Town.
Anis Mehmeti (born 9 January 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Premier League club Ipswich Town. Born in England, he plays for the Albania national team.

Azor Melo Matusiwa (born 28 April 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Ipswich Town. Matusiwa began his career at Ajax, playing for the youth division. He made one appearance for Ajax at the senior level during the 2017–18 season, in the final game of the season.
Cédric Kipré (born 9 December 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Ipswich Town. Born in France, he represents the Ivory Coast national team.

Christian Timothy Walton (born 9 November 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Ipswich Town. Walton began his professional career at Brighton & Hove Albion after graduating from the club's academy, having previously been in the academy at Plymouth Argyle for eight years.

Chuba Amechi Akpom (born 9 October 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Ipswich Town. A graduate of the Arsenal academy, Akpom made his senior debut in 2013 and featured in several domestic and European matches for the club.

Daizen Maeda (前田 大然, Maeda Daizen; born 20 October 1997) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for Premier League club Ipswich Town and the Japan national team. Maeda began his career with Matsumoto Yamaga before spells with Mito HollyHock, Marítimo and Yokohama F. Marinos, where he finished as the J1 League top scorer in 2021.
Dara Joseph O'Shea (born 4 March 1999) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Ipswich Town, whom he captains, and the Republic of Ireland national team.
Darnell Anthony Furlong (born 31 October 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Premier League club Ipswich Town.

David Robert Edmund Button (born 27 February 1989) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Ipswich Town. A product of the Tottenham Hotspur academy, Button came to prominence at Brentford in 2013. He earned 31 caps for England from U16 to U20 level.
Emersonn Correia da Silva (born 16 July 2004), known simply as Emersonn, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Ipswich Town.

Florentino Ibrain Morris Luís (born 19 August 1999), known as Florentino is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Ipswich Town. Born in Angola, he has represented Portugal at youth level.

Gary Paul O'Neil is an English professional football manager and former midfielder who is the manager of Premier League club Ipswich Town. He was appointed on a three-year contract to succeed Kieran McKenna, following a successful short-term stint managing Ligue 1 side Strasbourg.

Issa Laye Lucas Jean Diop (born 9 January 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Ipswich Town. Born in France, and a former France youth international, he plays for the Morocco national team. Diop began his career at his hometown club Toulouse, making his senior debut during the 2015–16 season.
Jack Raymond Clarke (born 23 November 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Ipswich Town.

Jack Henry Philip Taylor (born 23 June 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Ipswich Town. Born in England, he represents the Republic of Ireland national team.
Jacob John Greaves (born 12 September 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Ipswich Town.

Jaden Richard Philogene-Bidace (born 8 February 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Ipswich Town. He is a graduate of the Aston Villa Academy and has represented England at youth level.

Julio César Enciso Espínola (born 23 January 2004) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or striker for Premier League club Ipswich Town and the Paraguay national team.

Kasey Ian Robert McAteer (born 22 November 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or right winger for Premier League club Ipswich Town. Born in England, he represents the Republic of Ireland national team.
Kjell Scherpen (born 23 January 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Ipswich Town.

Leif Davis (born 31 December 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Ipswich Town. Born in Newcastle upon Tyne, Davis spent time in the youth systems at Wallsend Boys Club and Morecambe before joining Leeds United in 2018. He helped Leeds win promotion to the Premier League in 2020.
Marcelino Ignacio Núñez Espinoza (born 1 March 2000) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Ipswich Town and the Chile national team.
Saša Lukić (born 13 August 1996) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Ipswich Town and the Serbia national team.
Sindre Walle Egeli (born 21 June 2006) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Ipswich Town and the Norway national team.
Zian Flemming is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for Premier League side Ipswich Town.
